name: ws-p4-wifi6-poe-eth
title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-POE-ETH
notes: ESP32-P4NRW32 (32 MB PSRAM), 32 MB flash (GD25Q256 on the schematic; the wiki says 16 MB in one place); the ESP32-C6 companion isn't used. Pin-identical to the ESP32-P4-ETH (ws-p4-eth) with the 802.3af PoE module fitted. IP101GRI with IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50), reset GPIO51, address 1. Pins: Waveshare wiki (ethernetbasic demo) and schematic. microSD on SDMMC slot 0 (CLK 43, CMD 44, D0-D3 39-42) on LDO channel 4; supply switch on GPIO45 on by default. Power LED only.
